_meta.notes: Per Q15-Q25 [RESOLVED 2026-05-11]. 10B.1a shipped schema + UI shell; 10B.1b ships the four spell-research handlers (research_magic for spell targets, rewrite_spell, replace_spell, scribe_spell). research_magic for magic_item / construct / monster targets is deferred to 10B.1c/e/f. manage_assistant is included as a registered no-op trivial restricted (its supervise-assistants effect is consumed by 10B.1c item-creation handlers). Per Q21 [RESOLVED 2026-05-11], all four spell-research activities require physical presence at the library used to launch the project; location_kind='at_library' + location_ref='library:<id>' enforces this via the executor's existing absence-accumulator semantics. Full location-resolver wiring lands in 10B.1h polish. Per Q17, the v1 research_magic spell-target picker is restricted to existing spells from acore/pc catalogs — no custom-spell builder.

param_schema.target_spell_key: String (for project_kind=spell: registry key for the spell being researched)
param_schema.library_id: String (FK to libraries(id); for spell research becomes location_ref; for construct: optional design-step library)
param_schema.item_name: String (for project_kind=magic_item: name of the crafted item)
param_schema.item_category: weapon | armor | shield | scroll | potion | wand | rod | staff | ring | wondrous
param_schema.effect_kind: one_use | charged | permanent_unlimited | permanent_per_turn | permanent_per_3_turns | permanent_per_hour | permanent_3_per_day | permanent_per_day | permanent_per_week | weapon_plus_1 | weapon_plus_2 | weapon_plus_3 | armor_plus_1 | armor_plus_2 | armor_plus_3
param_schema.primary_spell_key: String (for magic_item: imbued spell — must be in character_spell_formulas)
param_schema.primary_spell_level: int (for magic_item: spell level being enchanted)
param_schema.base_item_key: String (for weapon/armor: FK to data/equipment/base_equipment.json item_key)
param_schema.precious_materials_gp: int (optional, +1 throw per 10,000 gp, cap = base_cost)
param_schema.special_components_xp: int (optional, monster XP value used as components, in addition to base cost)
param_schema.workshop_id: String (for magic_item / construct: FK to workshops(id), becomes location_ref as workshop:<id>)
param_schema.gp_committed: int (debited at launch; for spell=1,000gp×level, for magic_item=full base + precious materials, for construct=2,000gp×HD + 5,000gp×special_abilities)
param_schema.name: String (for project_kind=construct: the new construct's name)
param_schema.hit_dice: int (for construct: 1+ and <= 2× caster level per RAW L388)
param_schema.special_abilities: Array[String] (for construct: each name = 1 special ability; standard immunity package counts as one per RAW L408)
param_schema.armor_class: int (for construct: optional; defaults to floor(HD/2) per RAW L407)
param_schema.location_kind: stronghold | with_owner | wilderness_hex | dungeon_room | laboratory | other (for construct/crossbreed instance)
param_schema.location_ref: String (for construct/crossbreed: id of the location)
param_schema.monster_action: crossbreed (v1 only; future: scratch for monster-from-scratch per Q19)
param_schema.progenitor_a_name: String (for crossbreed: name of first progenitor — free-text in v1)
param_schema.progenitor_b_name: String (for crossbreed: name of second progenitor)
param_schema.progenitor_a_hd: int (for crossbreed: <= caster level per RAW L423)
param_schema.progenitor_b_hd: int (for crossbreed: <= caster level per RAW L423)
param_schema.progenitor_a_alignment: lawful | neutral | chaotic (used for crossbreed alignment derivation per RAW L430-432)
param_schema.morale: int (for crossbreed: better of two progenitors per RAW L451)
param_schema.movement_kind: progenitor_a | progenitor_b | both (per RAW L434-436; 'both' counts as +1 ability)
param_schema.additional_types: Array[String] — Judge-discretion non-fantastic types (beastman | enchanted_creature | giant_humanoid | humanoid | ooze | vermin per RAW L459)
param_schema.laboratory_id: String (for crossbreed: FK to laboratories(id); required per RAW L471)
param_schema.initial_reaction: hostile | unfriendly | neutral | friendly | helpful (optional; v1 supplies Judge's reaction roll result per RAW L482; future polish: roll in handler)

activities.effect_summary: Unified magical-research backend with project_kind dispatch. For project_kind=spell: 14 days/level, 1k gp/level, throw vs level_table + (spell_level/2). For project_kind=magic_item: cost/time from RAW magic_item_creation_table (one_use 500gp×level/7days×level → permanent_unlimited 500gp×level×50/100days×level; weapon_plus_1 5,000gp/30days×base_cost/10; etc.). Formula previously-crafted same-template gives -50% cost+time + half-level target modifier. Workshop is required for magic_item (parallel to library for spell research). Success creates crafted_magic_items row + inventory_items row; failure loses gp+time.

param_schema.assistant_character_ids: Array[String] (optional; assistants being supervised this period)

activities.effect_summary: Per ax_campaign_play.xml §manage_assistant L733-742: a L9+ spellcaster may supervise 1 + INT bonus assistants. Each assistant performs one additional magic item creation task per work session under supervision. v1 10B.1c: handler validates eligibility and records the supervisor relationship; the actual parallel item-creation orchestration is a future polish item (waits on the full assistant entity model).

param_schema.target_spell_key: String (spell to rewrite into the new spellbook)
param_schema.gp_committed: int (1,000 gp per spell level, debited at launch)
param_schema.library_id: String (FK to libraries(id); recovered work happens at a library)

activities.effect_summary: Rewrite a single lost spell into a new spellbook per RAW §rewrite_spell L756-766. 7 days + 1,000 gp per spell level. No throw. On completion: re-add spell to character_spells (in repertoire) if missing; idempotent if already present.

param_schema.new_spell_key: String (spell to swap in; must be in character_spell_formulas)
param_schema.target_spell_level: int (1-9; must equal level of both spells)

activities.effect_summary: Swap a repertoire entry per RAW §replace_spell L768-779. 7 days + 1,000 gp per spell level. No throw. Both spells must be at the same level; new spell must already be in character_spell_formulas. On completion: remove old from character_spells, add new to character_spells. Old formula is NOT lost — character_spell_formulas keeps the old entry.

param_schema.target_spell_level: int (1-9; caster must be able to learn spells of this level)
param_schema.source_kind: scroll | spellbook (scroll is consumed; spellbook is preserved per RAW)
param_schema.source_ref: String (inventory_items.id for scroll OR spellbook owner character_id)

activities.effect_summary: Scribe a spell into the character's spellbook (character_spell_formulas) per RAW §scribe_spell L781-792. 7 days regardless of spell level. No gp cost in RAW (the scroll or formula access is the cost). On completion: add to character_spell_formulas (idempotent via UNIQUE constraint); if source_kind='scroll', delete the scroll inventory_items row. Scribing from another spellbook does NOT erase the original.
